title: Hearty Smoked Kenyan Smoked Salmon Skewers
description: A briny and flaky Kenyan dish featuring smoked salmon with a smoky flavor, perfect for adventurous eaters, this recipe is ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly. It combines the richness of smoked salmon with the warmth of African spices.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a blender, combine lemongrass, garlic, ginger, paprika, coriander, cumin, salt, and black pepper to make a marinade.
Blend the marinade ingredients until they form a smooth paste.
Cut the smoked salmon into 1-inch cubes and place them in a bowl.
Pour the marinade over the salmon and mix well to coat.
Thread the marinated salmon cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the grill with olive oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until they are cooked through.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with fresh lemongrass and a side of roasted vegetables.
